original_question: Kim ya fara sana'ar kula da gida kuma yana lissafin yawan ribar da zai samu daga abokan cinikinsa. Yana da abokan ciniki 3 a yanzu, amma yana magana da wasu 5 masu yuwuwar kasancewa abokan ciniki kuma yana jin ƙarfin gwuiwar samun su ya haɗa dasu cikin lissafinsa. Gidan kowane abokin ciniki zai buƙaci kwalabe 2 na sinadarin wanki da yankin tsumma don tsaftacewa gida guda. kwalabe na sinadarin wankin zai kai $2 kowanne, shi kuma yankin tsumma zai kai $5 kowanne. Waɗannan su ne kawai kuɗin da zai kashe. Ya ƙididdige cewa jimillar kuɗin shigar kowane mako zai zama $92. Riba ita ce bambanci tsakanin jimillar kuɗin shiga da kuma kuɗi, don haka ribar nawa, a lissafin dala, Lucas zai samu kowane mako?
